newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-HELISSIO, PILSUDSKI MEET IN CLASSIC REMATCH.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-HELISSIO, PILSUDSKI MEET IN CLASSIC REMATCH.

text.p: Europe's champion race-horse Helissio will line up against Breeders' Cup Turf champion Pilsudski in a tasty opening to the French Group One season, the Prix Ganay at Longchamp on Sunday.
The last time they met was a no contest as Helissio blew Pilsudski away by five lengths in last October's Arc de Triomphe.
But since then Pilsudski has gone on to big race success at Woodbine in the Breeders' Cup and he prepared strongly at Newbury race-course in England last weekend.
British-trained Pilsudski will have the services of a pacemaker in the form of Trojan Sea, also trained by Michael Stoute.
Helissio, who dead-heated for third in last November's Japan Cup, is expected to start favourite, however, following a winter in Dubai and a good piece of trackwork on Monday.
